dct_title_s: Nova et accurata totius Regni Scotiae : secundum omnes provincias et adjacentes insulas, exquisito studio determinatae, delineatio / cura et sumtibus Matth. Seutteri, S. Caes. et Reg. Cath. Majest. Geogr. Augustae Vindel.
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; 3 Millaria Germanica "1"; Manuscript "50" at top left corner of sheet.; Vignette at top left by the title shows a group of builders with materials: stones, wood, etc. Nearby are piles of game animals, birds, and fish, some in baskets. Further to the right, people are unloading casks from a small boat. In the distance, more boats are on the water. In the upper right corner, around the scale, two more people in a boat examine the land as herons wheel overhead, some with coins or stones [white stone in a heron's beak symbolizes discretion and wisdom?] in their beaks.; Date partially based on printing privilege given in 1741 by Karl VI, as shown by text under vignette at top right: "Cum grat. et priv. S. R. I. Vicariat[us], in partib[us] Rheni, Svev. et Jur. Francon."; Text at bottom right: "And. Silbereysen S[?]ulps".
